# ContHunt

> ContHunt is a short-form video research tool for marketers, creators and ecommerce teams. Its Deep Search takes one question, searches TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, watches 500 to 1,000 videos in under five minutes and returns a ranked answer backed by the video data.

Last updated: 2026-11-06

ContHunt supports three platforms today: TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. For each analyzed video it reports the hook, the content, the audience, a possible virality concept and the metrics, plus how relevant the video is to the question that was asked. Scores are ContHunt's analysis of the content and its fit to the question. They are not measured viewer retention. After a Deep Search finishes you can keep talking to the agent to dig further into the results.

## Product facts

- What it is: a research product for finding and analyzing short-form video, so teams can see what hooks, formats and trends work in a niche before they brief a creator or plan an ad.
- Platforms: TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts. No other platform is supported today.
- Deep Search: breaks a question into sub-questions to answer and parameters to score, builds keyword searches, analyzes 500 to 1,000 videos in under five minutes, then ranks them and answers with citations to the video data.
- Viral Now: a public page of top-performing short-form videos across 20 niches, with up to 30 ranked videos per niche.
- Tracking (experimental): follow public accounts and selected videos, and keep daily cumulative snapshots to review competitor growth.
- AI boards: save and organize videos from your research.
- MCP server: AI agents can use ContHunt through the hosted MCP server at https://mcp.conthunt.app. Sign-in is with a ContHunt account.
- App: https://agent.conthunt.app

## Pricing

Prices are in US dollars and are as listed on https://conthunt.app/pricing, which is the source of truth. Every plan starts with a 1-week free trial. Yearly billing is shown by default and costs less per month than monthly billing. Hunt credits are one pool that searches and tracking both spend: a keyword search costs one hunt credit per platform it queries, so 3 across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. AI credits pay for video analysis, Deep Search, chat and insights.

- Pro: $25 per month billed yearly ($300 a year) or $29 billed monthly. 600 hunt credits and 3,000 AI credits per month. 2 daily agents, Deep Search (x200), MCP access, mid-tier AI models and competitor tracking.
- Creator: $63 per month billed yearly ($756 a year) or $79 billed monthly. 3,000 hunt credits and 15,000 AI credits per month. Everything in Pro, plus 5 daily agents, frontier AI models, Deep Search (x500) and upcoming platforms as they launch.
- Research: $151 per month billed yearly ($1,812 a year) or $189 billed monthly. 12,000 hunt credits and 60,000 AI credits per month. Everything in Creator, plus 25 daily agents, Deep Search (x500), Deep Search (x1,000) coming soon, and access to experimental features.

## Resources (articles)

- [Using ContHunt with AI agents through MCP](https://conthunt.app/resources/using-conthunt-with-ai-agents-through-mcp): Connect ContHunt to Claude, Codex or Cursor, then run hook research, board curation and competitor teardowns from your agent. Setup and prompts included.
- [Competitor content tracking: what to measure daily and why](https://conthunt.app/resources/competitor-content-tracking-what-to-measure-daily): Daily snapshots of a rival's public videos show growth curves, not just totals. The metrics, formulas and weekly review questions that matter.
- [Build a weekly trend radar for your niche](https://conthunt.app/resources/build-a-weekly-trend-radar-for-your-niche): A 45-minute weekly routine that sorts formats, sounds, topics and products into emerging, rising, peaking and fading, with a one-page template.
- [Reading virality: the metrics that matter beyond views](https://conthunt.app/resources/reading-virality-beyond-views): Views are the loudest number and the least comparable. Five ratios, with formulas and a worked example, to find the videos actually worth studying.
- [How Deep Search works: from one question to 500 analyzed videos](https://conthunt.app/resources/how-deep-search-works): What happens between your prompt and a cited answer: questions and parameters, a keyword plan, 500 to 1,000 videos watched, and a ranked result you can question.
- [Finding winning products from short-form signals](https://conthunt.app/resources/finding-winning-products-from-short-form-signals): A seven-signal scorecard for judging whether a 'made me buy it' product has real demand or just one lucky video, with a worked example and a kill list.
- [UGC ad formats that sell: a field guide with brief templates](https://conthunt.app/resources/ugc-ad-formats-that-sell-a-field-guide): Seven UGC formats, when each one fits, how the beats run, and a brief line for each. Plus the rights, disclosure and testing checklist buyers need.
- [The 3-second rule: a hook taxonomy for short-form video](https://conthunt.app/resources/the-3-second-rule-a-hook-taxonomy): Nine hook patterns, what each puts on screen in the first 3 seconds, when it fits, and how to tag your niche's videos to see which ones win.
- [How to research TikTok hooks before you brief a creator](https://conthunt.app/resources/research-tiktok-hooks-before-you-brief-a-creator): A six-step process that turns 200+ videos in your niche into a hook brief a creator can shoot from, with a template you can copy.

## Blog (articles)

- [YouTube Shorts Public Search Benchmark 2026](https://conthunt.app/blog/youtube-shorts-public-search-benchmark-2026): This YouTube Shorts public search benchmark is a dated sample of 74 unique Shorts from 79 observations, not a private retention or revenue study.
- [Instagram Reels Algorithm: How Distribution Actually Works](https://conthunt.app/blog/instagram-reels-algorithm): Instagram ranks Reels with their own system, not one master algorithm. It predicts a full watch, a like, a reshare, and a visit to the audio page.
- [Instagram Reels Hashtags That Still Help Discovery](https://conthunt.app/blog/instagram-reels-hashtags): Instagram Reels hashtags still help as topic labels. Use about 3 to 5 specific tags after a plain first caption line, and skip generic or mismatched trend tags.
- [YouTube SEO Tool Options Compared](https://conthunt.app/blog/youtube-seo-tools): YouTube SEO tools split by job: Studio for your own search and retention, one overlay for keywords or bulk edits, and ContHunt for public short-form examples.
- [YouTube Shorts Hashtags in Title vs Description](https://conthunt.app/blog/youtube-shorts-hashtags-title-vs-description): Where to put YouTube Shorts hashtags: title versus description, how many YouTube may show, and a simple test so you stop stuffing both fields.
- [YouTube Tags vs Hashtags: What to Use on Shorts](https://conthunt.app/blog/youtube-tags-vs-hashtags): YouTube tags are hidden keywords for misspellings. Hashtags are clickable labels in the title or description. Write the title, then a few hashtags.
- [How Long Can YouTube Shorts Be in 2026?](https://conthunt.app/blog/how-long-can-youtube-shorts-be): YouTube Shorts can run up to 3 minutes. Keep most ideas at 15 to 60 seconds, and use the longer range only when a tutorial or story needs it.
- [Short-Form Video Best Practices: Hooks, Captions, Hashtags](https://conthunt.app/blog/short-form-video-best-practices): A strong short-form video makes one promise, opens in the first second or two, uses a small hashtag set, and is judged on retention and saves.
- [YouTube Shorts Thumbnail Best Practices 2026](https://conthunt.app/blog/youtube-shorts-thumbnail-best-practices-2026): Shorts need a readable cover on search and channel grids. Upload a custom thumbnail when the account has it; otherwise choose a clear frame from the video.
- [YouTube Title Character Limit 2026: Best Length for Videos and Shorts](https://conthunt.app/blog/youtube-title-character-limit-2026): A YouTube title can be 100 characters. Write most titles in the 45 to 70 range and put the promise in the first 40 so a short preview still makes sense.
- [Best Time to Post YouTube Shorts in 2026](https://conthunt.app/blog/best-time-to-post-youtube-shorts-2026): There is no universal best time to post YouTube Shorts in 2026. Test morning, midday, and evening on similar Shorts, and keep only the window that repeats.
- [Best Social Media Analytics Tools: Choose by Data Source and Job](https://conthunt.app/blog/social-media-analytics-tools): Choose social analytics by the data source: native dashboards for your accounts, connected reports for workflows, and public research for other posts.
- [TikTok Analytics in 2026: What to Track and Why](https://conthunt.app/blog/tiktok-analytics): TikTok analytics should change the next video through completion, rewatches, shares, and audience fit. A view count does not show that the hook held attention.
- [The Ultimate Content Ideas Guide for 2026](https://conthunt.app/blog/content-ideas): A content idea worth filming names a specific person, promise, and proof. Build the list from public short-form patterns, then cut what you cannot show.
- [How to Grow Your YouTube Shorts Channel: Complete 2026 Guide](https://conthunt.app/blog/how-to-grow-youtube-shorts-channel): Grow a YouTube Shorts channel by staying on one topic, holding viewers through a tight Short, and posting one or two strong videos a day instead of a flood.
- [Instagram Reels Content Ideas That Get Watched](https://conthunt.app/blog/instagram-reels-content-ideas): A Reel gets watched when the opening states one topic and the spoken line, on-screen text, and caption match. Test one of 15 formats against your watch time.
- [Best vidIQ Alternatives (Free and Paid)](https://conthunt.app/blog/vidiq-alternatives): YouTube Studio is the best free vidIQ alternative for your own search and retention. TubeBuddy fits bulk edits. ContHunt fits public short-form research.
- [YouTube Shorts Algorithm & Viral Hooks Guide 2026](https://conthunt.app/blog/youtube-shorts-algorithm-2026): The 2026 Shorts system tests whether the right viewers keep watching. State one niche promise, show it first, then read swipe, retention, and search terms.
- [YouTube Shorts Analytics Guide 2026: Metrics & Tools](https://conthunt.app/blog/youtube-shorts-analytics): Read YouTube Shorts in Studio against your baseline: views, shown in feed, chose to view, retention, and traffic. No universal swipe benchmark exists.
- [YouTube Shorts Best Practices 2026: Hooks, Posting, Retention](https://conthunt.app/blog/youtube-shorts-best-practices): YouTube Shorts best practices in 2026 start with a clear first-second promise, tighter edits, and a weekly retention review before you add more uploads.
- [Best Instagram Analytics Tools Compared](https://conthunt.app/blog/best-instagram-analytics-tools): Pick Instagram analytics by data access: Insights for accounts you manage, a reporting suite for team exports, and public Reels research for creative patterns.
- [Best Social Media Monitoring & Tracking Tools (2026 Comparison)](https://conthunt.app/blog/best-social-media-monitoring-tools): The best social monitoring tool depends on the watch job: mentions, inboxes, media coverage, competitor profiles, or public short-form video.
- [BuzzSumo Pricing vs. 2026 Alternatives: A Value Comparison](https://conthunt.app/blog/buzzsumo-pricing-alternatives): Check BuzzSumo's live pricing page, then match it to the job: broad web and PR research, or daily public short-form research, which is a different buy.
- [Can You Use Copyrighted Music on YouTube Shorts in 2026?](https://conthunt.app/blog/can-you-use-copyrighted-music-on-youtube-shorts): Use copyrighted music on YouTube Shorts only with rights you can defend, or audio YouTube supplies. A Content ID claim can block, track, or monetize it.
- [15 Best Competitor Analysis Tools Compared](https://conthunt.app/blog/competitor-analysis-tools): Pick a competitor analysis tool by the evidence you need: search, traffic estimates, social reporting, audience research, or public short-form video.
- [The Best ContHunt Alternatives for 2026: Content Intelligence Comparison](https://conthunt.app/blog/conthunt-alternatives): ContHunt researches public short-form video. Choose Metricool, Hootsuite, or Sprout Social when the job is scheduling, listening, or enterprise reporting.
- [How to Find Winning Short-Form Content in 2026](https://conthunt.app/blog/find-winning-short-form-content): Winning short-form content beats that account's usual reach. Find it by comparing recent public posts, then keep only patterns that repeat.
- [The Best Hootsuite Alternatives for Startups in 2026](https://conthunt.app/blog/hootsuite-alternatives-startups): Startups replace Hootsuite by splitting the work: a light scheduler to post, native analytics for results, and ContHunt for short-form research.
- [How Long Can an Instagram Reel Be? (2026 Guide)](https://conthunt.app/blog/how-long-can-an-instagram-reel-be): Instagram Reel length limits can vary by account and rollout. Start at 15 to 30 seconds for discovery, and go longer only when the story needs the extra time.
- [How to Edit YouTube Shorts: The Ultimate 2026 Strategy](https://conthunt.app/blog/how-to-edit-youtube-shorts): Edit a YouTube Short by locking the opening first, changing the picture often enough to hold attention, and cutting anything that does not pay off the promise.
- [How to Identify Market Trends: The 2026 Intelligence Guide](https://conthunt.app/blog/how-to-identify-market-trends): Identify a market trend by watching which short-form topics are accelerating on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts, then testing that signal before you change the plan.
- [How to Track YouTube Shorts Competitors: The 2026 Strategy](https://conthunt.app/blog/how-to-track-youtube-shorts-competitors): Track YouTube Shorts competitors from public videos and same-window view growth. Retention stays private. Review openings and unanswered comments weekly.
- [Instagram Reels Analytics: Metrics and Review Workflow](https://conthunt.app/blog/instagram-reels-analytics): Review a Reel's watch time with reach, saves, and shares, and compare similar posts over the same window. Your account is the baseline, not a universal cutoff.
- [Instagram Reels vs. YouTube Shorts Analytics: The 2026 Comparison](https://conthunt.app/blog/instagram-reels-vs-youtube-shorts-analytics): YouTube Studio shows whether a Short held viewers. Instagram Insights shows reach, saves, and shares. Do not compare raw Reels views with raw Shorts views.
- [Metricool Pricing and Alternatives: The 2026 Comparison Guide](https://conthunt.app/blog/metricool-pricing-alternatives): Metricool is a scheduling and reporting tool. Read the live plan page, compare alternatives by the job you need, and do not treat a blog price table as a quote.
- [Best Sprout Social Alternatives for 2026 (Enterprise & Small Business)](https://conthunt.app/blog/sprout-social-alternatives): The best Sprout Social alternative depends on the job. Use Metricool, Buffer, Agorapulse, or Socialinsider for operations, and ContHunt for short-form research.
- [Best Free TubeBuddy Alternatives for YouTube Growth in 2026](https://conthunt.app/blog/tubebuddy-free-alternatives): For free YouTube SEO, use YouTube Studio and vidIQ's extension. For Shorts hooks, use ContHunt. TubeBuddy's free tier is mostly tags and a publish-time hint.
- [TubeBuddy Review 2026: Is It Still Relevant for Modern Creators?](https://conthunt.app/blog/tubebuddy-review): TubeBuddy is still relevant in 2026 for bulk library maintenance. It is a weak primary growth tool for Shorts, where retention research matters more than tags.
- [TubeBuddy vs. vidIQ: The Ultimate 2026 Comparison](https://conthunt.app/blog/tubebuddy-vs-vidiq): TubeBuddy is stronger for bulk YouTube management. vidIQ is stronger for ideas and trends. Neither replaces ContHunt for public short-form hook research.
- [What is Content Intelligence? The 2026 Strategic Blueprint](https://conthunt.app/blog/what-is-content-intelligence): Content intelligence turns your analytics and public short-form patterns into the next test you publish, instead of stopping at a view count.
- [100+ YouTube Shorts Ideas for Every Niche (2026 Master List)](https://conthunt.app/blog/youtube-shorts-content-ideas): The best YouTube Shorts ideas name one niche, one promise, and a payoff visible in the opening, then get checked against public outliers before you film.
- [Best Hashtags for YouTube Shorts](https://conthunt.app/blog/youtube-shorts-hashtags-guide): Use a few YouTube Shorts hashtags that match the video. YouTube may show up to three from the description and ignores every hashtag once the count passes 60.
- [YouTube Trending Searches: How to Find Topics People Search For](https://conthunt.app/blog/youtube-trending-searches): YouTube has no public list of exact search volume. Start with Studio Trends, then autocomplete and Google Trends, and keep each source's evidence separate.
- [How to Monetize YouTube Shorts: Current YPP Rules and Revenue Paths](https://conthunt.app/blog/how-to-monetize-youtube-shorts): Eligible creators monetize YouTube Shorts in YPP. Ads between Shorts fund a Creator Pool, and creators keep 45% of their allocation. There is no fixed rate.
- [Best YouTube Tracker Tools Compared](https://conthunt.app/blog/youtube-tracker): Use YouTube Studio for a channel you manage, a public stats page for subscribers, and research tools for videos. ContHunt is not a live subscriber counter.
